official: 神奈川県地方警察職員定数条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 審議結果

name: 警察職員の定数を改める
summary: 条例で定める警察職員の定数表を改めます。また、令和9年3月31日まで、職員の区分ごとに、定数へ別表の人数を加える特例を設けます。
changes: 警察職員の定数表を改める

en.name: Revises the police personnel quota
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Kanagawa Prefecture Local Police Personnel Quota Ordinance
en.summary: Revises the table of police personnel quotas set by the ordinance. Also establishes a special provision, until March 31, 2027, to add the number listed in a separate table to the quota for each personnel category.
changes: Revises the table of police personnel quotas
Adds, until March 31, 2027, the number listed in a separate table to the quota for each personnel category
